name: AWS infrastructure with CloudFormation
description: AWS infrastructure managed by CloudFormation without Terraform.

definitions.name: Purpose
definitions.defaultText: Make only the agreed CloudFormation change. Define the expected stack and resource outcome before editing.

definitions.name: Target environment
definitions.defaultText: Identify the AWS account ID, region, stack name, parameter set, and deployment environment. Confirm the active identity before cloud operations.

definitions.name: Resource scope
definitions.defaultText: Edit only the named templates and stacks. Check nested stacks and identify resources that may be replaced or removed.

definitions.name: Credentials and secrets
definitions.defaultText: Use the existing IAM role and approved parameter or secret store. Do not print credentials or embed secrets in templates or change-set output.

definitions.name: Stack protection
definitions.defaultText: Inspect stack status, termination protection, stack policy, parameters, and rollback settings before proposing an update. Do not bypass protections without separate approval.

definitions.name: Template checks
definitions.defaultText: Run cfn-lint and CloudFormation template validation where configured and available. Report unavailable tools rather than claiming validation; do not silence findings without explanation.

definitions.name: Change-set review
definitions.defaultText: When cloud access is authorized, create and inspect a CloudFormation change set. Review replacements, deletions, IAM capabilities, and parameter changes; a change set is a preview, not an executed deployment.

definitions.name: Execution approval
definitions.defaultText: Show the account, region, stack, and reviewed change-set effects. Wait for explicit approval before executing the change set or updating resources.

definitions.name: Execute
definitions.defaultText: After approval, execute the reviewed change set through the existing workflow. Stop and re-review if the change set is no longer valid or its effects changed.

definitions.name: Proof
definitions.defaultText: After authorized execution, inspect stack status and events, confirm relevant resource health, and report rollback results or unresolved failures.
